title: reminders/<language>.json, <language> zh-CN, ja or ko
description: The texts of map reminders in one language, <language> being zh-CN, ja or ko (zh-Hant is converted from zh-CN), in the translation repository CuleSKY/nerv-translations; English's file, reminders/en.json, has its own schema. Each text is one line in which {variable} stands for a value the reminder fills in, each text with its own variables: it uses every one of them and no other; {{ and }} are literal braces. NERV's backend takes these files when it is released, checking them again. A text left out shows in English. The QQ bot's texts (qq_*) are Simplified Chinese only: reminders/zh-CN.json has every one of them and ja and ko none, which the release checks.
